description: Track A stage 2 capability manifest: which exports are async capabilities, which are reactive hosts (their first argument is a compute), and the async-free runtime entry the capability linker may select when a whole graph is proven async-free. Kept equal to src/index.sync.ts (tests/sync-entry.test.ts).
featureExportsDescription: Core runtime slicing (documentation/plans/core-runtime-slicing.md): per link-time feature switch of @solidjs/signals (src/core/features.ts), the exports whose use needs it. The capability linker turns a switch off for a fully known graph that imports none of them (a namespace import uses them all). COMPILED_SEAMS is decided by the compiler configuration, never by imports. In a build, the linker reads each application module's compiled output instead of its authored imports: the names it references, ITERABLE by the `yield*` left in it, COMPILED_SEAMS by the seams it requests.
